rows.question: Can luck be removed from the equation at all?
rows.known: It cannot be removed from a single result, and no method here claims to. What can be done is to state the chance a run of results is indistinguishable from randomness, and to report an interval rather than a point estimate. The repository already carries a permutation p-value, Holm adjustment, Brier scores and bootstrap intervals for the closed NBA study, so the method exists; the NFL sample does not.
rows.missing: Enough NFL outcomes to separate signal from noise, and a pre-registered test-deciding rule. One week of games cannot distinguish skill from luck for any strategy.
